title: Packing for a Business Trip
paragraphs: Nurul punya perjalanan bisnis penting besok pagi, dan ia mengemas kopernya larut malam setelah seharian penuh bekerja, mencoba mengingat semua yang mungkin ia butuhkan untuk tiga hari bepergian.
Ia menulis daftar sederhana: dokumen, pengisi daya laptop, pakaian formal, dan sajadah kecil yang selalu ikut dalam perjalanannya, apa pun tujuannya atau sesingkat apa pun perjalanan itu.

Di tengah mengemas, ia hampir lupa membawa adaptor untuk stopkontak listrik luar negeri, dan hanya menyadari kesalahan itu karena ia memeriksa ulang daftarnya sekali lagi sebelum menutup ritsleting kopernya.

Keesokan paginya, di bandara, ia merasa tenang alih-alih cemas, karena ia telah bersiap dengan teliti malam sebelumnya. Nurul telah belajar bahwa sedikit persiapan di malam hari menghemat banyak stres keesokan paginya.
answerKey: Nurul has an important business trip tomorrow morning, and she is packing her suitcase late at night after a full day of work, trying to remember everything she might need for three days away. She writes a simple checklist: documents, laptop charger, formal clothes, and a small prayer mat that always travels with her, no matter the destination or how short the trip might be. Halfway through packing, she almost forgets her adapter for the foreign electrical sockets, catching the mistake only because she double-checked her list one final time before zipping the suitcase closed. The next morning, at the airport, she feels calm rather than anxious, since she prepared carefully the night before. Nurul has learned that a little organization the evening before saves a lot of stress the following morning.
